name: residue-unaddressable-keys
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): Paths: keys of another type (byte string 4101, float f93c00 = 1.0, true f5, null f6) and text keys the step grammar cannot write ("4" = 6134, "a.b" = 63612e62) are not addressable: residue keyed #<hex> (#6134, #63612e62, #4101, #f93c00, #f5, #f6) and written back in key order 4101 < 6134 < 63612e62 < 64666c6167 (flag) < f5 < f6 < f93c00. Reading step 4: 1, 1.0 and true are three keys, so uid still reads 1. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
